{{Spoiler}}

'''Warped stroganoff''' is the secret meal of the [[Warped Fungus|warped fungus]]. It heals {{Hp|12}} and grants {{EffectLink|Invisibility}} for 10 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/warped_stroganoff.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Warped fungus, a [[steak]], dough, a milk bottle and a bowl. The recipe is taught by a [[Cooking Recipe]] sold by an Apprentice [[Cook]]. Unlike the other stroganoffs, crafting it returns the milk bottle's glass bottle.
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 1.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|12}} and gives Invisibility for 10:00. Making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?'' The bowl is given back.

=== Cook ===
An Apprentice Cook sells 4 warped stroganoff for 1 [[obol]].

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
